title: Intel Samples D-Series GPUs and Shifts to Open Agentic AI Infrastructure
summary:
Initial shipments of the company's new graphics processors have reached customer sites to enable the build-out of autonomous AI agents. Intel has begun sampling its D-Series GPUs and expanding its associated infrastructure to accelerate the development of open platforms for the emerging agentic AI era.

The strategy marks a transition toward standardized, vendor-neutral architecture instead of the proprietary solutions typically used in the industry. By prioritizing interoperable systems, Intel intends to capture demand from enterprise customers deploying autonomous AI across diverse and mixed hardware environments.
